messages:
danielle: Heads-up  we need a decision on two items for next sprint: 1) stacked-area vs small-multiples for 'Spend by project' and 2) bulk invoice export UX. I prototyped both.
prashant: For long tails (20+ projects) stacked-area gets messy. small-multiples scale better for comparison.
olga: Small-multiples good for comparison, but dashboard real estate is tight. Maybe a hybrid: stacked by default with a toggle to expand into small-multiples grid for >8 projects?
maya: Toggle sounds fine. Default stacked helps show total trend; expansion helps drilling. We should persist the user's last view per-org.
danielle: Agreed on persistence. Also: if expanded small-multiples, we should limit to first 12 projects and surface "Show more" pagination.
prashant: Accessibility: each small-multiple needs descriptive aria-label like "Spend sparkline for Project Foo, Jan024 to Feb025, total $12.4k" so screen reader users can orient.
accessibility-bot: Reminder: contrast check  avoid using more than four hues that are <4.5:1 when rendered at 12px. Pattern overlays are recommended.
olga: Noted. Now on invoices: current "Bulk export" modal asks for date range but doesn't clarify formats. Support tickets show people expect CSV or ZIP of PDFs.
danielle: Proposal: modal should have explicit radio options: ( ) Download invoices (PDF ZIP)  ( ) Export ledger (CSV). Also add explanation text: "PDFs are per-invoice; CSV is line-item ledger for accounting."
maya: +1. Add ability to select scope: Org vs Project. If project selected, label files with project slug.
prashant: Also add a confirmation step showing estimated file size and number of invoices before starting export. Huge exports can fail.
danielle: Good idea. For very large exports (>100 invoices) we should queue and email a link when ready.
olga: Copy nit: modal button currently says "Start". Change to "Request export" (for queued) and for immediate small exports show "Download now".
maya: And aria-describedby on the scope toggle explaining implications: "Org exports include invoices across all projects; project exports only include invoices for the selected project."
danielle: I'll update the prototype with: stacked default, toggle to small-multiples (persist pref), small-multiples paginated at 12, accessible aria-labels for charts, invoice modal with radio choices, scope selector, estimated size, and queued-email fallback for big exports. Link: https://figma.com/file/klmn5678 (updated frame pinned).
prashant: Sounds good. Please add a dev ticket for the export queue + notification.
olga: I'll run an a11y smoke after dev preview.
maya: No blockers from PM side.
danielle: Thanks team, moving to backlog items.
